description:
Search the MedicalRecords.com provider directory for hospitals, clinics, physician practices, urgent care centers, and specialty facilities across the United States.

Returns contact information, medical records department details, phone numbers, fax numbers, the EHR/EMR system used, patient portal information, and records retrieval instructions.

Use this tool when a user:
- Asks how to request or get medical records from a specific hospital or doctor
- Needs contact information for a provider's medical records or ROI (Release of Information) department
- Wants to know which patient portal a health system uses
- Is looking for a hospital or clinic by name, city, or state
- Needs fax numbers or mailing addresses for sending records requests

Returns up to 10 matching providers sorted by relevance. Use state parameter to narrow results to a specific state.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 5, max 10.

query.description: Search query — provider name, hospital name, city, or health system. Minimum 2 characters. Examples: "Mass General", "Cleveland", "Kaiser Permanente"

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state code to filter results (e.g., "MA", "CA", "TX")

name: search_providers
